residual_risk: The reload is demand-driven: it fires on an /api/* request when a poll interval has passed, so a board added while no page is open is noticed on the next request, not on a wall-clock tick. No timer was added on purpose (a serve with no viewer should cost nothing).
Board identity is the keyBoards key plus root: pointing boards.json at a different checkout of the same repo#board rebuilds that board's state (one refetch) rather than keeping it.

A drawer left open on a board that was removed mid-session gets a 404 on its next detail poll; the page already clears a filter whose board left (web/index.html:497), so the board itself does not go blank.
hkb serve was not exercised against live GitHub in this session (no network for gh in the worker); coverage is the injected-deps HTTP tests.

results.summary:
The served board set is now live. `reloadBoards` in src/serve.js re-runs `serveContexts` at most once per poll interval, driven by the requests the page already makes — no timer, nothing re-read while nobody is watching, no GitHub call. A board that appeared is added and addressable on that same request; one that left the list stops being served and its cache goes with it; a board still in the list keeps its state object (cached cards, generation counter, detail cache), so a reload never blanks or refetches a working board. `boards`/`byKey` became re-derivable `let` bindings, and `boardsPayload` reads one list for the whole payload so a concurrent reload cannot desynchronise its snapshots from its entries. `--repos` (and the `deps.contexts` test seam) stay static. A stale entry's "skipping ..." line and an unparsable boards.json each log once, not once per poll, and a half-written list keeps the boards the server already holds instead of taking the page down.

The reload clock is a `deps.now` seam, so tests drive the real request path with a clock they move by hand rather than a test-only reload entry point.

Draft PR #104 on branch worktree-kb-101-1, rebased on main (after #103 landed). Beyond the stated file scope I also fixed the README paragraph #97 added ("the list is read once ... only after you restart the server"), now false, and refreshed docs/wiki/features/web-board.md, whose covers: SHA for src/serve.js this change would otherwise have made stale — AGENTS.md requires the page move with the code. src/board.js was not touched, as the contract asked.
